nodes.name: Todd Copy Gate
nodes.notes: DORMANT until ship-time. Flip SHIP_TO_TODD to true and set TODD_EMAIL when Shane gives the ship order. Todd then receives the same dispatch ticket + recording on every call to his demo line — his own owner-alert experience.

nodes.name: Caller Copy Gate
nodes.notes: Sends the caller their own request-received copy when the agent captured an email. Capture-only language: explicitly not a confirmed reservation. Silent by design — the agent must NOT promise an email until this is witnessed working twice (Verified-Alive law).
